dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: A life without change, paired with unchanging coffee...

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: From the perspective of work, such trivial matters won't even make for good conversation — that much is true.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: I'm a Gestionnaire at the Palais Mermonia. I guess you could call me an old colleague of Arouet's.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: Arouet's opinions could be considered quite extreme in the office, but by cafe standards, they're quite ordinary.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: It must be said, though, that there can be no complaints about his coffee-making skills. Quitting his old job to run this place has been one of the best decisions of his life.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: Indeed — the aroma of the coffee available here is wonderful. I can only hope that Arouet will keep making it this way.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: But I do have my reservations about his statement that "coffee is the source of life."

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: You must know, I'm sure, that not everyone loves coffee for its taste, but for its ability to impart wakefulness.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: Where I work, there is much that many cannot control in their lives already — at least leave them their opinion on coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: See you, and may you stay happy.
